'''Mars's Purugly''' (Japanese: '''マーズのブニャット''' ''Mars's Bunyatto'') is [[Mars]]'s main {{OBP|Pokémon|species}} in the {{pkmn|games}}, {{pkmn|animation}}, and {{pkmn|manga}}.

==In animation==
===''Pokémon the Series''===
====History====
====={{aniseries|DP}}=====
[[File:Mars and Purugly.png|thumb|200px|Purugly and Mars]]
Purugly debuted in ''[[DP097|Double Team Turnover!]]'' during Team Galactic's stealing operation in the [[Celestic Town Historical Research Center]]. It battled {{Ash}}, {{an|Dawn}}, and [[Cynthia]] for the [[Lustrous Orb]] and proved itself to be very powerful.

In ''[[DP110|Steeling Peace of Mind!]]'' and ''[[DP111|Saving the World From Ruins!]]'', Purugly was once again by Mars's side during her operation on [[Iron Island]] to scan [[Mt. Coronet]] for the location of the [[Spear Pillar]]. It battled and defeated {{MTR}}. 

In ''[[DP151|The Needs of the Three!]]'', Purugly was used to help capture {{DL|Lake guardians (anime)|Mesprit}} and {{DL|Lake guardians (anime)|Uxie}}. Later, in ''[[DP152|The Battle Finale of Legend!]]'', it was used to ward off Ash and {{ashfr}} before being defeated by {{AP|Pikachu}}. At the conclusion of the villainous team's plans, Team Galactic was arrested.

====={{aniseries|JN}}=====
In ''[[JNS02|The Arceus Chronicles (Part 2)]]'', Purugly was sent out to fight Ash and {{ashfr}}. It had a brief battle with [[Ash's Pikachu]] before going up against [[Brock's Blissey]]. Purugly was unable to land a single hit before {{an|Cynthia}} showed up and drove them off. They were later captured and tied up by her {{p|Roserade}}'s {{m|Power Whip}}.

===Personality and characteristics===
As a member of Team Galactic, Purugly is evil and very hostile, just like its Trainer.

===Pokémon Adventures===
[[File:Mars Purugly Adventures.png|thumb|Purugly in [[Pokémon Adventures]]]]
Purugly is the third Pokémon seen on Mars's team. Despite her large build, Purugly is a powerful battler than can hold her own in battles (although she can be comically be seen struggling trying to climb up a small step at one point). She was first seen in ''[[PS344|Belligerent Bronzor]]'', where she was used to cut the windmill that Mars had stolen so that they can use it to fly away. She was [[PS397|later]] used Purugly to battle {{adv|Diamond}}. She easily defeated [[Fantina's Drifblim]] that Diamond was riding on.

In ''[[PS411|Double Trouble with Dialga and Palkia I]]'', Purugly battled [[Crasher Wake]] and [[Gardenia]]'s Pokémon on the [[Spear Pillar]]. She was last seen lying next to her master, defeated.
